method: Streamed docker export of a never-started isolated read-only container; SHA-256 each regular file; sum its tar logical size. Owned container removed. No image rebuild or service change.
correction: The prior Docker inspect Size observation is preserved but must not be described as total uncompressed filesystem size. These metrics measure different things; directory/block overhead, shared storage and registry transfer are not inferred.
limitations: ARM64 only, unchanged qualified runtime; no new functional journey or benchmark.
Ingredient file inventory is not a completed licensed SBOM.
